description: Search Norwegian companies/organisations (Enhetsregisteret) by name + filters. Results under _embedded.enheter. navn=name (required; `name` is accepted as an alias), organisasjonsform=org form (e.g. ASA, AS, ENK), naeringskode=industry, forretningsadresse=business address. A row counts as a match only when its registered name contains every distinctive word of the query (legal forms such as AS/ASA are ignored): `found` is true only then, `_embedded.enheter` holds only matching rows, and rows that merely share a word are listed under `unmatched_candidates` with name_match:false. e.g. {navn:"equinor"} or {navn:"bank", organisasjonsform:"ASA", kommunenummer:"0301"}.

navn.description: Company name to search (required unless `name` is given), e.g. "equinor" or "Norsk Hydro ASA".
